The 'find anvil' task serves as an orientation/exploration task that leads the player to the crafting area where they can then complete the crafting task. The anvil area will contain the necessary gold ingots and crafting table needed for the second task, creating a logical multi-hop dependency where finding the anvil guides the player to the resources needed for crafting.
